metadata.title: On strongly pseudoconvex Kähler--Berwald manifolds
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we establish the equivalence between the Kähler--Finsler and Kähler--Berwald conditions for complex Finsler metrics. That is, a Kähler--Finsler metric always satisfies the complex Berwald condition: its Chern--Finsler nonlinear connection reduces to the Chern connection of a Kähler metric. We also provide, for the first time, smooth weakly Kähler--Finsler examples which are not Kähler--Berwald; and propose a condition that is formally stronger than weakly Kähler--Finsler, with equivalence holding in complex dimension two. Then we prove the de Rham decomposition and uniformization theorems for Kähler--Berwald manifolds, and show that every strongly pseudoconvex locally symmetric complex Finsler metric is both Kähler--Berwald and complex Einstein--Finsler. Additionally, we establish several rigidity theorems for the Kobayashi and Carathéodory metrics: $F_K$ is Kähler--Berwald if and only if it is Kähler; if the manifold is simply connected, then $F_C$ is Kähler--Berwald if and only if it is Kähler.
metadata.comment: 48 pages, no figures. The core results in the Kähler--Berwald setting were first announced at the Young Mathematicians Workshop on Several Complex Variables, Incheon, Republic of Korea, August 2026, when the equivalence between the Kähler--Berwald and Kähler--Finsler conditions had not yet been established
